title: Report history file (report-files/add)
journal: /solve/report-files add {{name}} file-name "{{file}}" frequency {{frequency}} report-defs ({{reportDefs}}) active? yes q
interactive: add → name → file-name → frequency → report-defs (list in parentheses) → active? yes → q
